title: ComLucro HTF Flip Strategy
summary: Wait for price to tap and reject a higher time frame POI, flip the latest main-time-frame supply or demand zone with displacement, return to the flip zone in premium/discount, then confirm entry on a lower time frame with MSS, VSR, breaker block, or mitigation block.

timeframes.higher: H4, H1, or M15 depending on trade profile
timeframes.main: M15 or M5 for structure and flip-zone detection
timeframes.entry: M1, M3, or M5 for confirmation and risk refinement

requiredConditions: Higher time frame unmitigated supply, demand, or FVG is identified
Price taps and rejects the higher time frame area
Main time frame shows the latest opposing zone fail
Price breaks and closes through that zone with displacement
Flip leg leaves visible inefficiency or imbalance
Flip zone is in premium for shorts or discount for longs
Price returns to the flip zone
Entry time frame confirms with MSS, VSR, breaker block, or mitigation block
Risk engine and active strategy profile approve the plan

bearishModel.htfContext: Price taps fresh or unmitigated higher time frame supply or bearish FVG and rejects.
bearishModel.mainTrigger: Latest demand reacts weakly, then breaks and closes below with bearish displacement.
bearishModel.flipZone: Last up-close candle or up-close candle cluster at the origin of bearish displacement.
bearishModel.entryTrigger: Entry-time-frame MSS, VSR, breaker block, or mitigation block after return to flip zone.
bearishModel.stop: Above entry-time-frame higher high or above flip-zone invalidation.
bearishModel.target: Sell-side liquidity below relevant swing low.

bullishModel.htfContext: Price taps fresh or unmitigated higher time frame demand or bullish FVG and rejects.
bullishModel.mainTrigger: Latest supply reacts weakly, then breaks and closes above with bullish displacement.
bullishModel.flipZone: Last down-close candle or down-close candle cluster at the origin of bullish displacement.
bullishModel.entryTrigger: Entry-time-frame MSS, VSR, breaker block, or mitigation block after return to flip zone.
bullishModel.stop: Below entry-time-frame lower low or below flip-zone invalidation.
bullishModel.target: Buy-side liquidity above relevant swing high.

invalidations: No higher time frame POI tap
No close through latest opposing supply or demand
Flip forms in the middle of nowhere
Risk engine rejects position size, symbol, or account rule

points: Liquidity sweep or clear liquidity target: 1
Entry time frame MSS or VSR: 1
